# SC-300 Conditional Access and SAML Evidence

91 screenshots captured on 10 October 2026.

> Review each image for tenant names, email addresses, identifiers, tokens, or other sensitive information before publishing. A standard header mask has been applied; it is **not** comprehensive redaction.

## Validation summary

- Hybrid identity: on-premises AD DS synced to Microsoft Entra ID.
- Finance dynamic group assigned to Microsoft Entra SAML Toolkit enterprise application.
- Frank successfully signed in to SAML Toolkit and completed MFA authentication.
- Emergency access administrator sign-in to Azure/Entra verified.
- Conditional Access policies created and evaluated; screenshots show Report-only results, and some sign-in events display Not Applied. Enforced CA must be independently verified before claiming enforcement.
